features: [1080P FHD VIDEO RECORDING]: Capture clear 1080P Full HD video for everyday vlogging, cycling, travel, outdoor activities and personal recording. The compact Q6 makes it easy to document important moments without carrying a bulky conventional camera.

[WI-FI CONNECTIVITY & APP CONTROL]: Connect the Q6 to a compatible smartphone through Wi-Fi and the supported mobile app for convenient camera access and supported functions. Ideal when you want greater flexibility while setting up or managing your recordings.

[ROTATABLE LENS FOR FLEXIBLE SHOOTING]: The adjustable rotatable lens lets you change the shooting direction more conveniently, helping you frame yourself or capture the scene around you. A practical feature for vlogging, cycling, travelling and handheld recording.

[NIGHT VISION FOR LOW-LIGHT RECORDING]: Built-in Night Vision helps improve visibility when recording in compatible low-light and darker environments. Useful for evening activities, indoor recording, travel and situations where normal lighting may be limited.

[MOTION DETECTION RECORDING]: Supported Motion Detection can help initiate recording when compatible movement is detected, making the Q6 useful for situations where you may not want to manually start every recording session.

[2.0" SCREEN FOR EASY VIEWING]: The built-in 2.0-inch display makes it convenient to frame your shots, review supported captured content and navigate camera functions directly from the device without relying entirely on another screen.

[PORTABLE HANDHELD & POCKET-FRIENDLY DESIGN]: Compact and lightweight construction makes the Q6 convenient to carry in your pocket, backpack or travel kit. Use it for cycling, hiking, holidays, outdoor adventures, everyday videos and on-the-go content creation.

[MADE FOR VLOGGING, CYCLING & TRAVEL]: Whether you're recording a travel diary, cycling journey, outdoor adventure or everyday vlog, the Q6 combines 1080P recording, Wi-Fi connectivity, a rotatable lens, Night Vision, Motion Detection and a built-in screen in one compact portable camera.

[SUPPORTS UP TO 128GB MEMORY CARD]: Store more videos and supported recordings with TF/microSD card support up to 128GB. The higher storage capacity helps reduce the need for frequent file transfers, making the Q6 convenient for travel, cycling, outdoor activities, vlogging and longer recording sessions. Memory card sold separately unless included with the selected package.
